panels.rationale: Single H&E 10X image of skin biopsy from milker's nodule case; article title disease-focused and in-text links Figures 5,6,7 to biopsy from the nodule with described epidermal and dermal changes. Histology panel shows epidermal thickening consistent with vocabulary histology finding, tagged as visual with additional described features in proposed_findings.
panels.attribution_text: Poudel et al. Milker's nodule: An under-reported and under-diagnosed occupational infection.. Clinical case reports 2020. doi:10.1002/ccr3.2850. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 6.
in_text_mentions: Histopathological examination of the skin biopsy from the nodule revealed compact hyperkeratosis with focal parakeratosis, irregular acanthosis, varying degree of spongiosis with exocytosis of lypmphocytes, and dermis revealing perivascular, periadnexal and interstitial lymphohistiocytic infiltrate extending to subcutis (Figures 5, 6, 7).
